# The Santa Barbara Independent

> > Local news and culture coverage for Santa Barbara County, including Goleta, Santa Maria, Solvang, and the Gaviota Coast.

The Santa Barbara Independent is a community newspaper covering local government, public health, business, arts, sports, and community events throughout Santa Barbara County. The publication provides in-depth reporting on issues affecting residents from the coast to the Santa Ynez Valley.

## Key Topics

- Santa Barbara
- COVID-19 pandemic response
- Santa Barbara County
- Santa Barbara City Council
- Joan Hartmann
- Gaviota Coast
- Public health
- Local government
- Community news
- Goleta
- Santa Maria
- Solvang
- Downtown Santa Barbara
- Metropolitan Theatres
- Centers for Disease Control

## COVID-19 Pandemic Coverage

- [Federal and State Tax-Payment Deadlines Extended to July 15](https://www.independent.com/2020/03/19/federal-and-state-tax-payment-deadlines-extended-to-july-15): IRS and California extend tax deadlines to July 15 due to COVID-19
- [Coronavirus Precautions Must Make Sense, Says Public Health Officer](https://www.independent.com/2020/03/04/coronavirus-precautions-must-make-sense-says-public-health-officer): Dr. Henning Ansorg assesses Santa Barbara County COVID-19 risks
- [Santa Barbara Movie Theaters Close](https://www.independent.com/2020/03/18/santa-barbara-movie-theaters-close): Metropolitan Theatres shuts Santa Barbara locations amid COVID-19 pandemic
- [Fire Department: In Response to the COVID-19 Outbreak](https://www.independent.com/2020/03/17/fire-department-in-response-to-the-covid-19-outbreak): Santa Barbara County Fire Department announces COVID-19 service changes
- [The Lessons of Coronavirus](https://www.independent.com/2020/03/11/the-lessons-of-coronavirus): Editorial comparing Trump's COVID-19 and climate change response failures
- [No to Cruise Ships Is the Preparation Santa Barbara Needs](https://www.independent.com/2020/03/09/no-to-cruise-ships-is-the-preparation-santa-barbara-needs): Opinion letter urging cruise ship ban amid COVID-19 outbreak concerns

## Local Government & Politics

- [Re-Elect Joan Hartmann](https://www.independent.com/2020/02/25/re-elect-joan-hartmann-2): Editorial endorsement for Joan Hartmann's 3rd District supervisor race
- [More than One Side to Das Williams](https://www.independent.com/2020/02/10/more-than-one-side-to-das-williams): Letter endorsing Das Williams for 1st District Supervisor election

## Crime & Public Safety

- [Panga Beached near Hollister Leads to Arrest of 20](https://www.independent.com/2020/03/12/panga-beached-near-hollister-leads-to-arrest-of-20): Coast Guard arrests 20 after 5,300 lbs marijuana seized at Hollister Ranch
- [Two Compton Crips Convicted of Post-Debris Flow Home Invasion](https://www.independent.com/2020/03/12/two-compton-crips-convicted-of-post-debris-flow-home-invasion): Adolph Washington Jr. and Davion Jones convicted for Montecito burglary
- [Butane Honey Oil Lab Explodes in Orcutt](https://www.independent.com/2020/02/18/butane-honey-oil-lab-explodes-in-orcutt): Albert Alvarado arrested after BHO lab explosion in Orcutt home
